# DisconnectedForeachInstruction

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" />

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `DisconnectedForeachInstructionInspection`

A statement inside a `foreach` body that uses no loop variable and nothing the
loop body changes produces the same effect on every iteration; it most likely
belongs before or after the loop. Optionally (off by default) the rule also
points at objects instantiated on every iteration that could be built once and
cloned.

## Example

```php{5,6,8,9,12,15,18}
<?php
/* @var array $orders */
$type = \ArrayObject::class;
foreach ($orders as $key => $order) {
    $box = new $type();
    $node = (new \DOMDocument())->createElement('row');

    syslog(LOG_INFO, $banner);
    while ($pending > 0) {
        usleep($pending);
    }
    if ($debugMode) {
        dump($settings);
    }
    switch ($mode) {
        default:
    }
    try {
        $warmup();
    } catch (\RuntimeException $problem) {
        report($problem);
    }

    echo '<br>';                        // E4: no variables
    if ($stop) { return; }              // E3
    $total += $order;                   // E2 + connected
    $copy = clone $template;            // clone: never reported
    $sink[] = 'seen';                   // accumulate
    $logger->push($order);              // D8a: $logger becomes modified
    $logger->flush();                   // connected through $logger
    preg_match('/x/', $order, $hits);   // D8b: $hits modified
    print_r($hits);                     // connected
    $meta->touch(compact('key'));       // D11: depends on $key
}

foreach ($groups as $group) {
    foreach ($group as $member) {
        echo $group;                    // D4: outer loop variable
    }
}

foreach ($rows as $row) {
    ?><td><?= $title ?></td><?php       // E5: inline HTML, loop skipped
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Create the object once before the loop and clone it here.</li>
<li>line 6: Create the object once before the loop and clone it here.</li>
<li>line 8: Statement does not depend on the loop; move it out.</li>
<li>line 9: Statement does not depend on the loop; move it out.</li>
<li>line 12: Statement does not depend on the loop; move it out.</li>
<li>line 15: Statement does not depend on the loop; move it out.</li>
<li>line 18: Statement does not depend on the loop; move it out.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| SUGGEST_USING_CLONE | bool | false | Enables D13 (object creation on every iteration). The upstream test suite runs with it enabled. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DisconnectedForeachInstruction": {
      "enabled": true,
      "options": {
        "SUGGEST_USING_CLONE": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DisconnectedForeachInstruction

/**
 * @noinspection DisconnectedForeachInstructionInspection
 */
```
